annotations.text:
THE WAY IN

Sign in, then Trips, then a trip opens on Today.

The G mark on the button is a PLACEHOLDER. Google ships the real asset and it drops in there.
The wording is "Continue with Google" rather than "Connect with" because Google's sign-in branding guidelines allow only a fixed set of strings, and Connect is not one of them.

Today is live. Tap a day header, tap a stop. Move to day, Edit note and Remove live under the kebab.

ADDING PLACES

Search is biased to the open day, not the whole planet. Places API takes a locationBias circle of up to 50 km, so the centre is the day's stops and the radius is a chip you can widen. Results outside it still appear, greyed, with the distance. Things already on the trip say so instead of offering to add twice.

Sign-in is Google. Drive is a separate, later consent, asked only when you first attach a file - see PLAN.md section 5.

PLANNER

Click any empty cell and the search opens right there, already scoped to that day and that hour. Sidebar is now Planned, uncollapsed and scrollable, with a small green arrow marking anything that came from your My Map. Two rows along the bottom: travel (plane and train) and where you sleep.

The one-time spreadsheet import is gone, as you asked. This view is the replacement.

Three ways to shape the day list. A is what the app screens are built on, because it is what you described. B and C are here so you can see what you are giving up. They are sketches, not proposals - say the word and I will build one out properly.
